- PARTY BUNTING generated £5.2k revenue TW, the highest-performing product, with 984 units sold across 53 orders.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER achieved £3.1k revenue TW from 1,144 units, representing the second-largest revenue contributor and highest order count at 58 orders.
- SMALL CHINESE STYLE SCISSOR showed exceptional growth with revenue up 19,919.5% WoW, selling 2,621 units TW, the highest unit volume across all products.
- Total revenue reached £27.9k TW compared to £13.6k LW, representing a 104.9% WoW increase.
- EDWARDIAN PARASOL NATURAL demonstrated strong year-over-year performance with revenue up 315.0% YoY.
- BLACK RECORD COVER FRAME grew 911.6% WoW and 199.7% YoY, generating £1.4k revenue TW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER contributed £2.1k revenue TW from 44 orders, ranking third in revenue generation.
- Total revenue increased 129.8% YoY, with TW revenue of £27.9k versus £12.1k LY.
